generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period ie 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24 2024-25 & 2025-26 Achieved in at least TWO financial years an average annual financial turnover (in all Class of Civil Engineering Construction Works only) of Rs 1.61 Lakhs. (Usually not less than the estimated annual payment under this contract) (Updated to the FY in which the tenders are invited. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10 percent year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited). The Turnover certificate issued by registered chartered Accountants along with UDIN

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as Assessed available tender capacity is A x N x 2.5-B where A is Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years at 2026-27 price level updated to the financial year N is equal to 0.25 year. B Value, at 2026-27 price level (updated to the financial year in which the tender is invited) of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 0.25 year (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited)

In the case of death of a contractor after executing / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of work
The agency should make their own arrangements for providing accommodation & conveyance to location, for their labor
The agency shall also be responsible and fulfill all statutory obligations under the statutory provisions such as PF etc, in respect of their personnel engaged under the contract
The increase in GST shall not be paid in extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
The amount put to tender is Exclusive of GST and the tenderer should quote without GST. However GST will be paid at prevailing Rate during billing
Any Modification/ corrections will be published in the kpp-portal. The bidders are advised to visit the kpp-portal web site regularly
